sections.heading: Protection controls
items: Improved app-list loading, scheduled block labels, VPN permission handling, and active-protection guidance.

sections.heading: Home Launcher
items: Added Classic and Glassy launcher themes with wallpaper-aware styling, a focused home layout, and configurable app-drawer controls.
Updated the fixed FocusFlow launcher shortcut to use the official FocusFlow app icon in both themes and their configuration previews.

sections.heading: Focus Session Reliability
items: Fixed stale Focus Mode and timed standalone state lingering after a session expired or the device restarted, so old sessions no longer keep apps blocked.
Deferred enforcement actions now re-check the current session state before redirecting or dismissing screens, preventing delayed callbacks from acting on an ended focus session.

sections.heading: Release Metadata
items: Updated FocusFlow to v1.1.3 (build 14).

sections.heading: Protect System Controls
items: Fixed protected Android settings screens when the feature is enabled.

sections.heading: Daily Allowance
items: Daily allowance enforcement improvements are still in progress and will be addressed in a later update.

sections.heading: Database Reliability
items: Solved database errors that could interrupt loading and prevent settings or task changes from being saved.

sections.heading: More Reliable App Blocking
items: Added a UsageStats foreground-app watchdog and improved recent-app return handling.
Improved OEM fallback behavior when Usage Access is unavailable.

sections.heading: FocusFlow Safety
items: Focus, Stats, Settings, and onboarding remain exempt from app blocking while protection is active.

sections.heading: Block Overlay Cleanup
items: Removed the duplicate React Native blocked-app banner; native blocking remains unchanged.

sections.heading: Navigation and Focus Workflow
items: Reordered bottom navigation and improved task-form keyboard behavior.

sections.heading: Accessibility and Enforcement
items: Improved recovery when Android restricts or stops AccessibilityService.

sections.heading: Focus and Defense
items: Improved PIN protection, standalone blocks, and defense-state recovery.

sections.heading: Stability
items: Improved boot recovery, alarms, notifications, and settings persistence.

sections.heading: Withdrawn release
items: This release was withdrawn.

sections.heading: Blocking and Permissions
items: Improved app blocking, permission guidance, launcher setup, and VPN protection.

sections.heading: Focus sessions
items: Improved active-session controls, task alarms, and break handling.

sections.heading: Core features
items: Added standalone blocks, daily allowance tools, blocked keywords, and stronger protection controls.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Improved startup reliability and task scheduling.

sections.heading: Initial native hardening
items: Improved AccessibilityService enforcement and native block overlays.

sections.heading: Protection
items: Added additional device and system-control protection.

sections.heading: Launcher
items: Added FocusLauncherActivity and launcher protection options.

sections.heading: Widgets and reports
items: Added the home-screen widget and weekly temptation report groundwork.

sections.heading: Enforcement
items: Added native foreground service and accessibility enforcement foundations.

sections.heading: Permissions
items: Added permission setup guidance and recovery paths.

sections.heading: Tasks
items: Added scheduled tasks, focus sessions, and reminders.

sections.heading: FocusDay
items: Added the first complete focus-session and app-blocking workflows.

sections.heading: FocusFlow
items: Initial release with focus sessions, app blocking, schedules, permissions, and settings.
